# Vendored Valhalla config generator

`valhalla_build_config.py` is Valhalla's own `scripts/valhalla_build_config`,
byte-identical to the tag in `VERSION`.

Valhalla reads a good many configuration keys with no default and throws at
startup when one is absent — `httpd.service.listen`, `loki.service.proxy` and
`httpd.service.timeout_seconds` among them. A hand-written config that covers
only the interesting keys therefore produces a service that will not start, and
the failure is a `boost::property_tree` exception naming one key at a time.

So the configs in this directory are generated: upstream's own defaults, with
RouteMaker's overrides merged on top by `scripts/build_valhalla_configs.py`.
Upstream's default set is the definition of complete, and taking it from the
pinned source means it stays complete across an upgrade instead of drifting.

Do not edit this file, and do not hand-edit the generated configs — change the
overrides in the build script and re-run it. The test suite regenerates and
compares, so an edit here fails rather than silently diverging.
